preguntaEn: MOST SKIDS:
opcionesEn: HAPPEN ON ICE.
WILL NOT HAPPEN WITH RADIAL TIRES.
ARE CAUSED BY GOING TOO FAST OR TRYING TO STOP TOO QUICKLY.

preguntaEn: IF YOU MUST USE A CELL PHONE WHILE YOU ARE DRIVING, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: REDUCE YOUR SPEED.
PULL OFF THE ROAD ONTO A SAFE AND LEGAL POSITION.
POSITION THE PHONE SO YOU CAN DRIVE AND SEE THE ROAD IN FRONT OF YOU.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE SHOULD BE TESTED ON THE VEHICLE TO STOPPED?
opcionesEn: SERVICE BRAKE.
PARKING BRAKE.
HYDRAULIC BRAKES.

preguntaEn: RETARDERS CAN BE USED:
opcionesEn: ONLY WHERE THEY ARE PERMITTED BY LAW.
ONLY FOR DOWNHILL BRAKING.
ONLY ON ROADS WITH POOR TRACTION.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS TRUE ABOUT COMMERCIAL VEHICLE HABIT OF SWINGING WIDE ON TURNS?
opcionesEn: OFF-TRACKING.
WIDE-ROUNDING.
SIDEWINDING.

preguntaEn: WHEN LOOKING AHEAD OF YOUR VEHICLE WHILE DRIVING YOU SHOULD LOOK:
opcionesEn: STRAIGHT AHEAD AT ALL TIMES.
TO THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE ROAD.
BACK AND FORTH, NEAR AND FAR.

preguntaEn: THE PURPOSE OF THE RETARDERS IS TO:
opcionesEn: HELP SLOW THE VEHICLE WHILE DRIVING AND REDUCE BRAKE WEAR.
APPLY EXTRA BRAKING POWER TO THE NON-DRIVE AXLES.
HELP PREVENT SKIDS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT ABOUT SPEED MANAGEMENT IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: IF YOU DOUBLE YOUR SPEED, STOPPING DISTANCE WILL DOUBLE.
EMPTY TRUCK AND LOADED TRUCKS WILL HAVE THE SAME STOPPING DISTANCE.
IF YOU DOUBLE YOUR SPEED, STOPPING DISTANCE WILL BE INCREASED BY 4 TIMES.

preguntaEn: WHEN HYDRAULIC BRAKES FAIL WHILE DRIVING, THE SYSTEM WON’T BUILD UP PRESSURE AND THE BRAKE PEDAL WILL FEEL SPONGY OR GO TO THE FLOOR. WHAT ACTION SHOULD YOU TAKE?
opcionesEn: PUSH DOWN ON THE BRAKE PEDAL AS HARD AS YOU CAN.
PUMP THE BRAKE PEDAL TO GENERATE PRESSURE.
PUT THE VEHICLE IN NEUTRAL AND SET THE PARKING BRAKE.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING HEAVY VEHICLE AND THE ROAD SURFACE BECAME SLIPPERY DUE TO THE RAIN. WHAT YOU SHOULD DO?
opcionesEn: DECREASE YOUR SPEED EVEN FURTHER FOR ADVERSE WEATHER.
ADJUST YOUR SPEED TO TRAFFIC.
TURN OFF YOUR 4-WAY FLASHERS.

preguntaEn: WHTS IS THE FIRST THING YOU SHOULD DO IF YOUR BRAKES FAIL WHILE GOING DOWN A HILL?
opcionesEn: GET OFF THE ROAD AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
TRY TO USE YOUR PARKING BRAKES TO STOP.
CALL OR RADIO FOR HELP.

preguntaEn: THE PROPER USE OF THE BRAKES WHEN GOING DOWN A LONG STEEP GRADE AFTER SELECTING A PROPER GEAR IS TO BRAKE UNTIL YOUR SPEED IS ABOUT _______ MPH BELOW THE POSTED SPEED FOR YOUR SAFETY AND RELEASE YOUR BRKAES.
TO CHECK THE FREE PLAY OF MANUAL SLACK ADJUSTERS OF S-CAM BRAKES, YOU SHOULD PARK ON:
opcionesEn: LEVEL GROUND, CHOCK THE WHEELS AND RELEASE THE PARKING BRAKES.
LEVEL GROUND AN APPLY THE PARKING BRAKES, THEN APPLY SERVICE BRAKES.
LEVEL GROUND AND DRAIN OFF AIR PRESSURE BEFORE CHECKING THE ADJUSTMENT.

preguntaEn: IF YOUR VEHICLE HAS AN ALCOHOL EVAPORATOR, IT IS HERE TO:
opcionesEn: ELIMINATE THE NEED FOR DAILY TANK DRAINING.
BOOST TANK PRESSURE THE SAME WAY THAT TURBOCHARGES BOSST ENGINE.
REDUCE THE RISK OF ICING IN AIR BRAKE VALVES IN COLD WEATHER.

preguntaEn: YOUR TRUCK HAS A DUAL AIR SYSTEM AND ONE OF THE SYSTEM LOSES ITS PRESSURE. WHAT WILL HAPPEN?
opcionesEn: BRAKE DRUMS WILL NOT BE FULLY PRESSURIZED.
THE MANUAL SLACK ADJUSTERS OF THE S-CAM BRAKES WILL NOT BE SET PROPERLY.
EITHER THE FRONT OR BACK BRAKE WILL NOT BE FULLY OPERATIONAL.

preguntaEn: WHY SHOULD YOU DRAIN WATER FROM COMPRESSED AIR TANKS?
opcionesEn: WATER LOW BOILING POINT REDUCES BRAKING POWER.
WATER CAN FREEZE IN COLD WEATHER AND CAUSE BRAKE FAILURE.
TO KEEP HEAT FROM AIR COMPRESSOR OIL.

preguntaEn: IF YOUR TRUCK OR BUS HAS DUAL PARKING CONTROL VALVES, YOU CAN USE PRESSURE FROM A SEPARATE TANK TO:
opcionesEn: BALANCE THE SERVICE BRAKE SYSTEM WHEN YOU ARE PARKED.
STAY PARKED TWICE AS LONG WITHOUT USING UP SERVICE AIR PRESSURE.
RELEASE THE SPRING EMERGENCY/PARKING BRAKES TO MOVE A SHORT DISTANCE.

preguntaEn: IF YOU MUST MAKE AN EMERGENCY STOP, YOU SHOULD BRAKE SO YOU:
opcionesEn: USE THE HAND BRAKE BEFORE THE BRAKE PEDAL.
CAN STEER AND SO YOUR VEHICLE STAYS IN A STRAIGHT LINE.
USE THE FULL POWER OF THE BRAKES TO LOCK THEM.

preguntaEn: THE SUPPLY PRESSURE GAUGE SHOWS HOW MUCH PRESSURE:
opcionesEn: IS IN THE AIR TANKS.
YOU HAVE USED IN THIS TRIP.
IS GOING TO THE BRAKE CHAMBERS.

preguntaEn: THE APPLICATION PRESSURE GAUGE SHOWS HOW MUCH AIR PRESSURE YOU:
opcionesEn: HAVE IN THE AIR TANKS.
ARE APPLYING TO THE BRAKES.
HAVE IN A MODULATING CONTROL VALVE.

preguntaEn: THE SPRING BRAKES USED ON TRACTORS AND STRAIGHT TRUCKS WILL BRING YOUR TRUCK TO A STOP WHEN THE AIR PRESSURE DROPS BELOW __________PSI.
THE AIR LEAKAGE RATE FOR COMBINATION VEHICLES (ENGINE OFF, BRAKES ON) SHOULD BE LESS THEN _____ PSI PER MINUTE.
HOW SHOULD YOU CHECK THAT YOUR SERVICE BRAKES ARE WORKING PROPERLY?
opcionesEn: PARK ON SLIGHT GRADE, DRAIN OFF AIR PRESSURE, SET PARKING BRAKE AND CHECK TO THE MOVEMENT.
PARK ON A LEVEL GROUND, CHOCK THE WHEELS, ENGAGE THE PARKING BRAKES WHEN YOU HAVE THE CORRECT AMOUNT OF AIR PRESSURE TO DO SO AND SHUT THE ENGINE OFF.
PARK ON LEVEL GROUND, WAIT UNTIL NORMAL AIR PRESSURE IS REACHED, RELEASE THE PARKING BRAKE AND MOVE FORWARD SLOWLY AT ABOUT 5 MPH. THEN APPLY THE BRAKES FIRMLY USING THE BRAKE PEDAL.

preguntaEn: EXCESSIVE USE OF THE SERVICE BRAKES RESULTS IN OVEHEATING WHICH CAN LEAD TO:
opcionesEn: IMPROPER ADJUSTMENT OF THE S-CAM.
INCREASED CONTACT BETWEEN THE BRAKE DRUMS AND BRAKE LINNNING.
EXPANSION OF THE BRAKE DRUMS.

preguntaEn: THE SUPPLY PRESSURE GAUGE SHOWS HOW MUCH PRESSURE:
opcionesEn: IS IN THE AIR TANKS.
TRACTOR BRAKE LINES.
TRAILER BRAKE LINES.

preguntaEn: TOTAL STOPPING DISTANCE FOR AIR BRAKES IS LONGER THAN THAT FOR HYDRAULIC BRAKES DUE TO _________ DISTANCE.
opcionesEn: BRAKE LAG.
REACTION.
EFFECTIVE BRAKING.

preguntaEn: THE USE OF AIR BRAKES ON LONG AND STEEP DOWNGRADE UNDER NORMAL CONDITIONS IS ONLY A SUPPLEMENT TO:
opcionesEn: THE USE OF THE SPRING BRAKES.
THE USE OF THE FRONT BRAKES LIMITING VALVE.
THE BRAKING EFFECT OF THE ENGINE.

preguntaEn: ANY TIME YOU PARK, USE THE PARKING BRAKES, EXCEPT:
opcionesEn: IF THE BRAKES ARE VERY HOT (E.G., AFTER JUST COMING DOWN A STEEP GRADE).
IF YOU ARE GOING TO TEST THE PARKING BRAKE MAKE SURE THAT IT HOLDS THE VEHICLE.
IF YOU WILL ONLY BE STOPPED FOR LESS THEN ONE HOUR.

preguntaEn: IF YOUR VEHICLE GETS STUCK ON A RAISED RAILROAD- HIGHWAY CROSSING, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: GET OUT OF THE VEHICLE AND AWAY FROM THE TRACKS.
TURN ON YOUR FOUR- WAYS FLASHERS.
USE REVERSE GEAR TO BACK UP OFF THE CROSSING.

preguntaEn: YOUR TRUCK OR BUS HAS A DUAL AIR BRAKE SYSTEM. IF A LOW AIR PRESSURE WARNING COMES ON FOR ONLY ONE SYSTEM, WHAT SHOULD YOU DO?
opcionesEn: REDUCE YOUR SPEED, AND DRIVE TO THE NEAREST GARAGE FOR REPAIRS.
REDUCE YOUR SPEED, AND TEST THE REMANING SYSTEM WHILE UNDER WAY.
STOP RIGHT AWAY AND SAFELY PARK. CONTINUE ONLY AFTER THE SYSTEM IS FIXED.

preguntaEn: YOUR TRUCK OR BUS HAS A DUAL AIR BRAKE SYSTEM. IF A LOW AIR PRESSURE WARNING COMES ON FOR ONLY ONE SYSTEM, WHAT SHOULD YOU DO?
opcionesEn: BRING YOUR VEHICLE TO COMPLETE STOP RIGHT AWAY AND SAFELY PARK. CONTINUE ONLY AFTER THE SYSTEM IS FIXED.
REDUCE YOU SPEED, AND TEST THE REMAINING SYSTEM WHILE UNDER WAY.
REDUCE YOUR SPEED, AND DRIVE TO THE NEAREST GARAGE FOR REPAIRS.

preguntaEn: THE SAFETY VALVE IS SET TO AUTOMATICALLY REDUCE PRESSURE AT _____PSI.
SOME AIR BRAKE SYSTEM HAVE AN ALCOHOL EVAPORATOR. WHAT MAY HAPPEN IF YOU DON’T KEEP THE PROPER LEVEL OF AN ALCOHOL?
opcionesEn: THE S-CAM MAY NOT TAKE BACK WHEN YOU RELEASE THE BRAKE PEDAL.
ICE MAY FORM IN THE AIR STORAGE TANK AND CAUSE A BRAKE FAILURE.
ICE MAY FORM ON THE BRAKE DRUMS AND WEAR THEM OUT.

preguntaEn: UNDER NORMAL CONDITIONS IN ORDER TO ENGAGE THE PARKING BRAKES DRIVER:
opcionesEn: TURN OFF THE ENGINE.
LET THE AIR OUT OF AIR BRAKE SYSTEM.
BE SURE THAT THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM IS FULLY PRESSURIZED.

preguntaEn: PARKING OR EMERGENCY BRAKES OF TRUCKS AND BUSES CAN BE LEGALLY HELD ON BY ____ PRESSURE.
opcionesEn: SPRING.
AIR.
FLUID.

preguntaEn: ALL AIR BRAKE EQUIPPED VEHICLES HAVE:
opcionesEn: A SUPPLY PRESSURE GAUGE.
AN AIR USAGE GAUGE.
A BACKUP HYDRAULIC SYSTEM.

preguntaEn: THE MODULATING CONTROL VALVE ALLOWS YOU TO CONTROL:
opcionesEn: SPRING BRAKES.
FRONT BRAKES.
AMOUNT OF AIR PRESSURE IN THE BRAKE SYSTEM.

preguntaEn: A SLACK ADJUSTERS FREE PLAY NEEDS TO BE ADJUSTED IF IT IS MORE THAN ABOUT______ HOW MANY INCHES WHEN YOU PULL HARD ON IT?
opcionesEn: ONE FOURTH INCH.
ONE HALF INCH.
ONE INCH.

preguntaEn: EMERGENCY STAB BRAKING IS:
opcionesEn: PRESS HARD ON A BRAKE PEDAL AND APPLY HAND VALVE UNTIL YOU STOP.
USE LIGHT STEADY PRESSURE ON THE BRAKE PEDAL.
BRAKE AS HARD AS YOU CANY, RELEASE THE BRAKES WHEN THE WHEELS LOCKED, PUT ON THE BRAKES AGAIN WHEN THE WHEELS START ROLLING.

preguntaEn: IN IDEAL CONDITIONS, A TRUCK OR A BUS WITH AN AIR BRAKE GOING AT 55 MPH WOULD REQUIRE STOPPING DISTANCE OF:
opcionesEn: LESS THAN 100 FEET.
MORE THAN 300 FEET.

preguntaEn: TO TEST AIR SERVICE BRAKES, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: STOP THE VEHICLE, PUT IT IN A LOW GEAR, DEPRESS THE SERVICE BRAKES, AND THEN GENTLY PULL AGAINST THE BRAKES.
BRAKE FIRMLY WHILE SLOWLY MOVING FORWARD.
BRAKE SLOWLY WHILE SLOWLY MOVING BACKIWARD.

preguntaEn: THE S-CAM:
opcionesEn: CONTROLS THE FLOW AIR TO EACH OF THE BRAKE CHAMBERS.
PULLS THE BRAKE SHOES AWAY FROM THE DRUM AND ALLOW THE WHEELS TO ROLL FREELY.
FORCES THE BRAKE SHOES AGAINST THE INSIDE OF THE BRAKE DRUM.

preguntaEn: WHY SHOULD YOU DRAIN WATER FROM COMPRESSED AIR TANKS?
opcionesEn: THE BOILING POINT REDUCES BRAKING POWER.
WATER CAN FREEZE IN COLD WEATHER AND CAUSE BRAKE FAILURE.
WATER COOLS THE COMPRESSOR TOO MUCH.

preguntaEn: THE AIR BRAKE LAG DISTANCE AT 55 MPH ON DRY PAVEMENT ADDS ABOUT ______ FEET.
opcionesEn: 12 FEET.
32 FEET.
52 FEET.

preguntaEn: WHEN IS IT OK TO LEAVE YOUR TRUCK UNATTENDED WITHOUT APPLYING THE PARKING BRAKES AND CHOCKING THE WHEELS?
opcionesEn: NEVER.
IF YOU WILL BE AWAY FROM THE TRUCK FOR A FEW MINUTES.
IF YOU ARE CONDUCTING A PRE-TRIP INSPECTION.

preguntaEn: THE BRAKE SYSTEM THAT APPLIES AND RELEASES THE BRAKES WHEN THE DRIVER USES THE BRAKE PEDAL IS THE ________ BRAKE SYSTEM.
opcionesEn: EMERGENCY.
SERVICE.
PARKING.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT A PROPER TIME TO APPLY THE PARKING BRAKES?
opcionesEn: TO BRAKE VEHICLE VERY HARD, IN OTHER WORD WHEN COMING DOWN THE STEEP GRADE.
TO USE PARKING BRAKES IF YOU PARK FOR LESS THAN 1 HOUR.
IF YOU ARE GOING TO USE THE PARKING BRAKES YOU NEED TO MAKE SURE THAT THEY WILL HOLD THE VEHICLE.

preguntaEn: AIR BRAKING TAKES MORE TIME THAN HYDRAULIC BRAKING BECAUSE AIR:
opcionesEn: BRAKE USE DIFFERENT BRAKE DRUMS.
TAKES MORE TIME TO FLOW THROUGH THE LINES THE HYDRAULIC FLUID.
BRAKES REQUIRE HEAVIER RETURN SPRINGS.

preguntaEn: A STRAIGHT TRUCK OR BUS BRAKE SYSTEM SHOULD NOT LEAK AT THE RATE OF MORE THAN _____ PSI PER MINUTE WITH THE ENGINE OFF AND THE BRAKES RELEASED.
opcionesEn: ONE.
THREE.
TWO.

preguntaEn: WHY SHOULD YOU DRAIN WATER FROM COMPRESSED AIR TANKS?
opcionesEn: THE LOW BOILING POINT OF WATER REDUCES BRAKING POWER.
WATER CAN FREEZE IN COLD WEATHER AND CAUSE BRAKE FAILURE.
TO KEEP FROM FOWLING TRE AIR COMPRESSOR OIL.
